subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the Diffs plugin ship SSR changed-files summary navigation and suppress interactive toolbar controls in static PNG/PDF exports as the intended viewer/export UX?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the issue is protected and changes user-visible viewer and exported artifact behavior rather than fixing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve Focused Diffs UX PR
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if maintainers accept the SSR summary/navigation card and image-mode toolbar suppression as the desired product behavior.

options.title: Request Export Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a real viewer plus PNG/PDF capture confirms the static artifact layout is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Limit the accepted work to summary/navigation or defer toolbar suppression if maintainers want separate design review.

recommendation.title: Approve Focused Diffs UX PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if maintainers accept the SSR summary/navigation card and image-mode toolbar suppression as the desired product behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the issue, authored the active candidate PR, and has prior diffs viewer/docs history.
